definitions.explanation: A soil amendment made from fallen leaves that have decomposed into a soft, dark, humus-rich material. Mixed into garden soil to improve its texture and water retention.

examples.japanese: ⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{腐葉土|ふようど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜる→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧。
examples.english: Mix leaf mold into the soil.

examples.japanese: {腐葉土|ふようど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかく→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Adding leaf mold makes the soil softer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{落|お}ち{葉|ば}→落ち葉：14108_ochiba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めて→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧{腐葉土|ふようど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}り→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧、⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧にまいた。
examples.english: I gathered fallen leaves from the garden to make leaf mold and spread it on the field.

notes:
Decomposed-leaf material used to improve garden soil. Sold in bags at garden centers and also made at home by letting fallen leaves rot.
